configuration.chunk_size_source: stored with the job when it was created

transport.source: constants passed to QuicTransportConfig in net.rs

connection.direction_note: cwnd, bandwidth_estimate, sent_* and lost_* describe packets THIS side sends. File data flows sender to receiver, so data-packet loss and the data path's congestion window are in the sender's summary; the receiver's values cover ACKs and requests
connection.scope_note: path and connection statistics cover the whole QUIC connection, which all transfers with this peer share

diagnostic_notes: note: the sender's upload limit is not visible here; check the sender's summary with the same file_key

flow_control_ceiling.kind: theoretical flow-control ceiling (window / RTT), not a throughput prediction

bytes_by_route.sampling: cached route (updated from the path API on every iroh path event) when each 1 MiB block was verified; samples[].route_cache_matches cross-checks it

download_limiter_process.scope: process-wide, shared by all transfers and peers in this direction

unavailable.applied_transport_config: noq does not expose the negotiated transport parameters; configuration values are the ones passed to the QUIC builder in net.rs
unavailable.congestion_controller_state: BBR's phase (Startup, Drain, ProbeBW, ProbeRTT) and app-limited flag are private in noq-proto; only cwnd, pacing rate, send quantum and bandwidth estimate are exposed
unavailable.connection_flow_control_blocked: noq-proto 1.4 never sends DATA_BLOCKED frames, so connection-window stalls are not observable
unavailable.packet_level_timing: per-packet timing is not collected; use path statistics (rtt, cwnd, loss) instead
unavailable.remote_rate_limit: the other device's rate limit is not sent over the wire; read it from that device's own summary
unavailable.stream_flow_control_blocked: noq-proto 1.4 never sends STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED frames, so per-stream window stalls are not observable; quic_write_blocked on the sender is indirect evidence only
